programs.title: Gogglebox
programs.desc: Prisoner, David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth, Countdown, First Dates, Scam Interceptors, and the News on local elections and Sir Keir Starmer.

programs.title: The Last Duel
programs.desc: Historical drama from director Ridley Scott. Trial by combat is the only option to save a noblewoman's honour. With Jodie Comer, Matt Damon, Adam Driver and Ben Affleck.

programs.title: Taskmaster
programs.desc: Coconuts are doused in vinegar, glue and Alex Horne's hair. Kumail Nanjiani shows off his super-human jaw strength. And don't be alarmed, it's just Joanna Page screaming... again.

programs.title: First Dates
programs.desc: Will former mayor Tracey take the plunge with toilet roll salesman Stuart? And can burlesque dancer Double D and professional singer Lee come together and hit all the right notes.

programs.title: Love Cheats: The Fireman Fraudster
programs.desc: The dramatic story of twin sisters defrauded by a sinister con artist who masqueraded as a generous, fun-loving firefighter but wasn't such a hero after all.

programs.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programs.desc: Jimmy Carr, Susie Dent and Rachel Riley host the battle of numbers, letters and laughs. Roisin Conaty and Phil Wang play Joe Wilkinson and Lou Sanders. With David O'Doherty.
